name: NVivo

why: This is a study-specific physical implementation of simulation-based surgical training, and its model-fidelity findings belong as an example on the canonical Simulation page.

rejected.verifier: The claim compares kidney-model fidelity in procedural tests but does not directly address learner-controlled simulation practice.
The claim concerns the anatomical realism of a preserved kidney model, not learners acting, observing consequences, and iterating in a simulation.
